Mine are the whole of ir_binary.py, whose four UI exceptions were f-strings:

  :43   MissingError  'No record found for xmlid=..., res_model=..., id=...'
  :96   UserError     'Expected singleton: ...'
  :103  UserError     'Record has no field ...'
  :105  UserError     'Field ... is type ... but it is only possible to stream ...'

MissingError and UserError are both in ERRORS_REQUIRING_GETTEXT, and both render
a dialog: ir.binary is what /web/image and every attachment download go through,
so these reach a reader in a browser rather than a log. All four are _() with
named placeholders now, and the two that used {x!r} quote the value in the message
instead, because %r in a _() is what E8504 counts.

reports 18 against a floor of 23, so the gate was already red by 5 in the falling
